_comment: No site recipe: smart-trust takes the smart-hiv shape (owner, 2026-10-14) — index.config.json names smart-base as the site's landing, and the mounted layers supply the steps from the cached AST. Only the workspaces remain.
name: @litlfred/smart-trust-site
_workspaces_comment: The mounted code layers, as workspaces, as folio-assistant's root package.json lists them: they import each other by package name (@litlfred/cat-harness, ...), and nothing publishes those packages, so a bare `bun install` in a mount fails with a 404. Owner, 2026-10-14: "Repo declares workspaces". The mounts are laid down from index.lock.json and gitignored; smart-base and bootstrap carry no dependencies and are not listed.
